scripts.config:pull: for k in text_model image_model max_retries retention_limit max_resume_attempts; do v=$(wrangler kv key get --binding CONFIG --remote "$k") && wrangler kv key put --binding CONFIG --local "$k" "$v"; done
scripts.//kv: Always reach local KV through these. Bare wrangler run from the repo root finds no wrangler.jsonc, silently leaves this app's KV untouched, and the next request is a normal billed run instead of the failure you were trying to force. npm runs a script with its own package as the working directory, so these cannot land in the wrong place.
